company_name: AccoTEST BU. of Beijing Huafeng Test & Control Co.,Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — AccoTEST provides specialized test systems for analog and mixed signal applications, crucial for semiconductor manufacturing and quality assurance.
summary: AccoTEST BU of Beijing Huafeng Test & Control Co., Ltd. offers performance-driven, cost-effective test systems for analog and mixed signal applications in the semiconductor industry. Their solutions are widely used by OSAT providers, fabless companies, IDMs, and foundries, particularly for testing next-generation power electronics like SiC and GaN devices.
